status: experimental, bounded research; no production eligibility change

scope.inputs: Real SID rows use already-counted benchmark subtunes; summaries also include synthetic controls and resampler-readiness fixtures. No corpus payload or per-track paths are included.
scope.projectionLimit: Samples are small, completion-ordered or deliberately stratified, and not population weighted. These measurements do not establish a whole-HVSC runtime or a sub-30-hour result.

adaptiveScreen.result: Final evidence, errors and completion matched in both engines. The 16-subtune sample had 32 attempts per engine under either schedule and no material cost saving.

syntheticControls.result: Early OSC3 reduced attempts 4 to 3; late ENV3 reduced 6 to 4; late CHARGEN still required all three masks. Exact final evidence matched.

sustainedUtilization.method: 64 full-horizon comparisons of the same 16 subtunes; per-core sampling every 250 ms.

fullClassificationDigestEquality.comparison: The multiset of all 64 final row digests is identical across all three reports (16 distinct digests, each repeated four times).
fullClassificationDigestEquality.meaning: Evidence equality across scheduling runs; it does not make the bounded workload representative of the corpus.

sustainedUtilization.result: Cost-ordered scheduling shortened this bounded batch by about 19.6% relative to original 19-worker order. This is not a whole-corpus runtime projection.
sustainedUtilization.limitations: Host occupancy includes unrelated work. The clean cost-ordered run excluded simultaneous builds/tests; package energy counters were inaccessible, so these data do not establish the cause of historical power drops.

forkReference.correctness: Cold and forked paths matched exact PCM bytes, timed traces, ROM-read counters and summaries for all reference rows; production remains cold-process isolated.
forkReference.limitations: Proof-of-concept full-reference cases only; mask variants, streaming transport and stateful-read screening are not qualified.

libSidplayEZ.profile: Native upstream timing probe; not Commander's patched/analogue-profile backend qualification.
libSidplayEZ.errorHandling: Errors are retained as unknown and are not promoted to equivalence. The EZ pilot had absent-ROM BASIC lanes stop before horizon; the 8-input native reference also retained one illegal-instruction stop.
libSidplayEZ.result: No factor-of-two improvement over the optimized native baseline was established. The pilot is too small and nonrepresentative for a production runtime projection.

independentReadinessTest.matrix: four PAL/NTSC clock values × four sample rates × 200 varying/reset batches
independentReadinessTest.comparison: Batched advanceClock readiness equals repeated upstream SINC input readiness.
independentReadinessTest.claimBoundary: Readiness parity only; amplitudes are intentionally not compared.

sampleClockPrototype.claimBoundary: This prototype checks sample-clock frame counts and timed writes only. It does not produce or compare PCM, establish audio equivalence, change eligibility, or support a corpus runtime projection. Stateful-read aborts remain unresolved evidence.

sampleScreenExperiment.stage: Earlier standalone conservative raw-register-screen, measured before the unread-CHARGEN shortcut was corrected.
sampleScreenExperiment.method: Sample-clock counts and timed writes feed the register comparator; the bounded decisions are checked against separately rendered native reSIDfp audio outcomes and the historical census states.
sampleScreenExperiment.result: Dense identical reference streams could conservatively yield full=false in this earlier raw-register stage. Every grant in these bounded samples agreed with the historical dual-engine compatible state; there were no false compatibility grants in the 4- or 16-subtune check.
sampleScreenExperiment.reproductionNote: The old standalone full-set counts (3/4 and 10/16 grants) are historical and are not expected to reproduce with the current corrected bench-sample-screen.ts.
sampleScreenExperiment.claimBoundary: The count/write comparator does not synthesize PCM. Audio verification is a separate measured native-render path. This is a small, prefix-selected pilot and is not corpus coverage or production qualification.

samplePipelineExperiment.stage: Final A/B after the sound unread-CHARGEN shortcut correction; full grants can exceed the earlier standalone raw-register stage.
samplePipelineExperiment.method: Run the exact-write native screen and sample-clock register screen on the same already-counted jobs. Resolve uncertain sets with measured native reSIDfp audio; extended samples also require identical reference repeats, and all references must cover the full horizon.
samplePipelineExperiment.historicalCheck: Separate 4- and 16-subtune sample-screen reports had zero false grants against historical dual-engine census states; each grant also passed measured native audio verification.
samplePipelineExperiment.claimBoundary: The 16 inputs are a small completion-ordered prefix. The 32.60% difference is native child-process CPU work, not coordinator-inclusive CPU or elapsed speedup, and is not a whole-corpus runtime projection. Sample-clock register evidence does not generate PCM; uncertain sets use a separate full-horizon audio path. No eligibility policy or publication changed.
samplePipelineExperiment.nextGate: Before any runtime promise or default activation, measure a representative stratified benchmark at target worker load and include coordinator, JSON, and FFT CPU cost.

sampleBoundaryControls.itsHipToBeCool: Clean reSIDfp reference; both ROM-set register grants agreed with separately rendered native audio.
sampleBoundaryControls.mexico86AndNewScener: Both references halted with illegal-instruction errors and returned no grants.
sampleBoundaryControls.limitation: These three boundary cases do not qualify SIDLite or any halted-tail optimization.
